_comment: Outcome of the 2026-10 discovery pass for inspected candidates. 'match' lists exact lower-case fragments of a candidate's DOI or URL (never a bare word of a title). A decision no harvested candidate matches is added to the inventory as a 'direct-search' candidate. inventory.py applies these as the candidate's status.

decisions.title: Estonia (register.muinas.ee) and Lithuania (kvr.kpd.lt) heritage registers

Cycle 2 retry (2026-10-01): Estonia reached through the Land Board WFS (gsavalik.envir.ee muinsuskaitse:kpo_malestised_241, 12,494 monuments with positions) — but the service carries no dating; dates exist only on the bot-walled register pages. Lithuania: geoportal.lt CSW 404, data.gov.lt API and get.data.gov.lt behind the same block page. Both stay blocked for dates; queued for a Wikidata cross-link (Estonian monument ID P2948 / Lithuanian KVR ID) as an alternative route. Cycle 3 retry: register.muinas.ee and kvr.kpd.lt both behind a Cloudflare challenge (403) on every path — a deliberate block, left to a browser check by the user (task 9).

decisions.title: ARIADNE portal — European archaeology catalogue (records with PeriodO-linked periods)
decisions.region: Iceland, Hungary, Finland, Austria, Germany, Bulgaria, Portugal and others
decisions.note: Harvested per country (API: 50/page, 10,000/query). decisions.title: AMCR — Archaeological Map of the Czech Republic (Archeologický informační systém ČR)
decisions.note: Found by the automated investigation (92 of its document records surfaced as candidates). Open OAI-PMH API, CC BY-NC 4.0 → private pack. 11,042 sites and 236,259 fieldwork events, each split into components with an AMCR period whose years come from its PeriodO-linked vocabulary (e.g. Early Middle Hillfort Period 801–850); 268,599 spatial units (PIAN) with geometry; 18,376 individual finds. Harvest started 2026-10-01 (fetch_oai.py, resumable). Harvest completed 2026-10-01: 69,860 dated phases (private pack); 34,305 restricted records and 184,788 negative units left out.

decisions.title: İslam Tarih Atlası / Atlas of Islamic History (v7.x)
decisions.note: Data inspected 2026-10-01: a derived web-app compilation. Its Yāqūt layer is geocoded by an AI model ("enriched via Claude API"), narratives are AI-completed, and its mint list mixes ancient and modern mints (e.g. Greek Haluntium, modern A Coruña) under "Islamic mints". Not used as a source; its underlying sources are followed instead (Bosworth, Nomisma, Hamburg Islamic Coin Corpus, al-Thurayyā — the last already integrated).

decisions.title: Hamburg Islamic Coin Corpus (HICC) — dated emissions per mint
decisions.note: Lead from the discovery chain of the Islamic History Atlas: coins with mint and year would date each mint's activity from emissions. Not yet inspected.

decisions.title: Nomisma.org mints (linked open data, CC BY)
decisions.note: Lead from the same chain: mint places with coordinates and identifiers; dating would come from coin corpora (OCRE, CRRO, HICC). Not yet inspected.

decisions.title: Treasure Map (ArcGIS): documented treasure hunts in Spain

decisions.title: Archaeological sites in the Eastern Anatolian Highlands (Chalcolithic–Iron Age)

decisions.title: Northern Ireland Wrecks database (MEDIN / ADS)

decisions.title: PORTIC / Navigocorpus ports and ship calls (18th c.)
decisions.note: 1,700 ports; 1,396 named in dated ship calls (1748–1799) → private spec porticports, one snapshot per year a dated call names the port (derived by scripts/historical-data/portic_years.py). Found by targeted maritime search (cycle 2), following the Navigocorpus DataCite records.

decisions.title: NorFish historical fisheries datasets 1368–1899 (25 datasets, figshare, CC BY 4.0)
decisions.note: Inspected (Iceland cod 1520–1871): one national catch series per year placed at a single sea-region centroid (coordinate uncertainty ~530 km), some years extrapolated — statistics, not located features. Followed from the Sound Toll search; the series could feed an Economic indicator later, not map points.

decisions.title: STRO Monetary Conversion Tables (Sound Toll Registers Online)
decisions.note: Currency conversion tables, no places. The STRO place list itself has no bulk download found (soundtoll.nl reachable; no data export) — queued as a chain lead.

decisions.title: Pleiades Ancient Cyprus Sites (ArcGIS)

decisions.title: Welsh historic boundaries: counties (OS 1st/2nd ed.), municipal boroughs, parliamentary constituencies, civil parishes (2nd ed.) — RCAHMW ArcGIS
decisions.note: Found by the cycle-3 weak-region investigation (same publisher as the integrated parishes and cantrefs). OGL v3 → public area spec wales-counties (counties 1st and 2nd edition, 47 boroughs, 74 constituency parts), each unit dated by its own survey years (1867–1913). Also found: tiled 1835–1857 coastal charts (MapServer tiles only) — queued for a tile-overlay feature.

decisions.title: Historic Townships of Wales pre-1840 (ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 1,063 township polygons, each with its own source and date (tithe maps, 1841/1851 censuses, estate maps, first-edition OS; 1806–1888, one 1939). Licence is per record: 698 units marked OGL v3 → public spec wales-townships; 332 marked Non-Commercial Government Licence or blank → private spec wales-townships-nc. 'c.1800' and '-' dates are not drawn.

decisions.title: Historic Poor Law Unions of Wales (OS 2nd edition, ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 64 unions (OGL v3) → part of public spec wales-counties, level 'poor law union', dated by the source's own second-edition OS survey window 1888–1913 (not by the 1834 Act).

decisions.title: Early Modern Weather Database (ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 3,456 dated weather records (1500s–1700s; diaries of Josselin, Pepys, Evelyn, chronicles, agricultural records). No licence on the layer → private spec earlymodernweather, kind 'event', each record at its own start/end years; imprecise locations drawn as approximate; type-only names not indexed as places.

decisions.title: Historic Municipal Wards of Wales (OS 1st edition, ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 46 wards (OGL v3) → part of public spec wales-counties, level 'municipal ward', dated by each ward's own first-edition OS survey years.

decisions.title: Historic Townships of Wales (1st edition OS; and the unversioned layer)
decisions.note: 323 of 367 townships are already in the pre-1840 township compilation with identical survey dates; the rest are spelling variants of the same units. Not drawn twice.

decisions.title: Historic Hundreds of Wales (1st edition OS, ArcGIS)
decisions.note: The same first-edition hundreds are already drawn as unions of their first-edition parishes (wales-parishes).

decisions.title: Average chemical composition of lake ores of Finland and North-Eastern Russia extracted in the late nineteenth century (PANGAEA)
decisions.note: 34 lake-ore workings (CC BY 3.0) → public spec finlandlakeore, kind mine; each over its own extraction years in the table (1871–1881, from Solitander 1882).

decisions.title: Strucke C14 Sweden
decisions.note: Radiocarbon dates (median calibrated years) of mostly prehistoric samples; not historical features — not integrated.

decisions.title: IE GSI MI GSRO Maritime Boundaries Irish Waters WGS84
decisions.note: Modern maritime boundaries; outside the atlas period.

decisions.title: ICEland-1: A geochronological database for reconstructing Late Quaternary glacier, relative sea level
decisions.note: Quaternary geochronology; not historical.

decisions.title: Dataset: Human-vegetation dynamics in Holocene South-Eastern Norway based on radiocarbon-dated charcoal
decisions.note: Radiocarbon-dated charcoal (environmental); not historical features.

decisions.title: Dive Lines - SeaRover layer
decisions.note: Modern survey dive tracks.

decisions.title: The Dataset for the Fauna et Flora Fennica project - Historical sighting data
decisions.note: Historical animal/plant sightings (environmental history), not a map category here; kept as a lead only.

decisions.title: Welsh georeferenced historical map scans (tiled MapServers: estate maps, tithe and enclosure surveys, charts, 1600s–1890)
decisions.note: 100 tiled services from the same publisher as the Welsh boundary layers; 94 whose own name gives the year the map was made are in the original-maps index (public/world/maps/georef-index.json) and can be laid over the atlas, streamed from the publisher's tile server and credited to the holder in each service's copyright line (National Library of Wales, North East Wales Archives, Bangor University, Grosvenor Estate). 6 without a year in the name (incl. the Barmouth–South Stack coastal chart) are left out rather than dated by guess.

decisions.title: Digital Atlas of Dioceses and Ecclesiastical Provinces in Late Medieval Europe 1200 to 1500
decisions.note: R. Dorin (gen. ed.), CC BY 3.0. The atlas' own time slices (c. 1250, 1350, 1450; 665–705 dioceses and 77–84 provinces each) → public spec dioceses-dorin, layer medieval-dioceses, each a snapshot of its year. The 'max' layers' StartDate/EndDate use 999/1501 as markers for 'before/after the atlas period', so they are kept in the vault but not used for dating.

decisions.title: Orthodox monasteries (Harvard CGA ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 512 monasteries and hermitages; no licence on the item → private spec orthodox-monasteries. 440 shown from their founding year to their closing year (open end when none); 56 founding years that are century midpoints (1350, 1450…) shown as the whole century; 46 without a founding year and 26 without coordinates left out.

decisions.title: Surveys of mills from 1794 to 1809 (Enquêtes sur les moulins de 1794 à 1809)
decisions.note: 20,313 records (Licence Ouverte) → public spec france-mills: 19,614 mill records as snapshots of their survey (an II → 1794, an X → 1801, 1809, as the dataset dates them), at commune centroids (approximate); 699 without coordinates left out; mill names not indexed as places.

decisions.title: İslam Tarih Atlası / Atlas of Islamic History (v6.5.2)
decisions.note: CC BY 4.0 web-app bundle (dynasties after Bosworth, al-Aʿlām scholars, Yāqūt's Muʿjam al-Buldān places). Not integrated: no per-record sources, narrative text and round population 'estimates' (Baghdad 800 = 1,000,000), coordinates rounded or automatically geocoded with self-assigned confidence — not verifiable to the temporal and spatial standard; al-Thurayya already covers the early Islamic places from a sourced gazetteer. Archive kept in the vault.

decisions.title: Sites archéologiques de la Lorraine médiévale (Nakala, ArkeoGIS export)
decisions.note: 6 records, CC BY-NC-ND; too small. Other ArkeoGIS exports on Nakala found are prehistoric (Bronze Age swords, Iron Age burials).

decisions.title: Historic Coastal Towns (Ireland, NMPF heritage assets)
decisions.note: 28 towns dated only by an origin class ('12-15th century Anglo-Norman'); no start or end years; towns already shown from other sources.

decisions.title: Rurland – The rural lands of north-eastern Gaul, from the late La Tène period to late antiquity (Nakala series)
decisions.note: Etalab 2.0. Nüsslein's per-century occupation files (2nd–5th c., zones 1–2; 152 sites, each with one occupation span) and the Moselle-valley site list (dated by century text) → public spec rurland, 202 records. Soil, geology and hydrography layers of the same series are environmental and not used; 1st-c. and High Empire files are before the atlas range or duplicate the century files.

decisions.title: Historical Oyster Habitat and Fisheries in English Coastal Waters (EA)
decisions.note: 227 oyster beds/fisheries (OGL) → public spec oyster-fisheries, kind fishery (Maritime), each in the year(s) of the historical account that mentions it (1154–1920s; mostly 1850s–1890s), with the reference; low-confidence locations marked uncertain.

decisions.title: NorfolkSuffolkChurches (ArcGIS)
decisions.note: 1,479 churches with 'Founded: Medieval' only; no years. Churches already shown from Historic England / Wikidata.
